name: Archaeologist

equipment.name: Wooden case containing a map to a ruin

feature.name: Historical Knowledge
desc: When you enter a ruin or dungeon, you can correctly ascertain its original purpose and determine which entity built it (for example, dwarves, elves, or humans). In addition, you can determine the monetary value of art objects more than a century old.

traits: I love a good puzzle or mystery.
I’m a bit of a snob about 'real' history versus folklore.
I share my knowledge with anyone who will listen.
I am constantly taking notes and sketching ruins.
I have no respect for those who would loot a site for profit.
I am always looking for the next big discovery.
I’m comfortable in tight, dark spaces.
I tend to talk about the past as if I were there.
ideals: Preservation. History must be preserved for future generations. (Good)
Knowledge. The past is a teacher we must all listen to. (Neutral)
Discovery. I want my name to be remembered alongside the great finds. (Any)
Greed. Artifacts are just things waiting to be sold to the highest bidder. (Evil)
Tradition. The old ways are the best ways because they đã worked for so long. (Lawful)
Change. By understanding the past, we can bring about a new future. (Chaotic)
bonds: I am searching for the legendary city of my ancestors.
I owe my mentor everything for teaching me the trade.
My reputation was ruined by a rival, and I must restore it.
An artifact I found was stolen, and I won't rest until I get it back.
I work to fund a museum in my hometown.
I seek a specific crown or scepter that belonged to a forgotten king.
flaws: I’m so obsessed with finding the past that I often ignore the present.
I have a secret collection of artifacts that should be in a museum.
I’m prone to take risks if it means seeing a new ruin.
I judge people based on their knowledge of history.
I’m suspicious of anyone else interested in my current project.
I once accidentally destroyed a significant archaeological site.

desc: An archaeologist learns about the long-lost and fallen civilizations of the past by excavating their ruins. You have spent years digging through the dust of dead empires, searching for artifacts that tell the story of how people lived and died long before your time.
